title: First Biennial Transparency Report of the Republic of Serbia
geographic_coverage: areas south of the Sava and Danube rivers
temporal_coverage: Sectoral climate impacts and adaptation reporting through 2024; crop comparison baseline 2011–2020.
methodology: Government BTR compiles sectoral climate-risk and adaptation reports; full English PDF read.
limitations: National self-report; spatial detail varies. The 2014 flood is not attributed to climate change.

title: Programme for Adaptation to Changed Climate Conditions for 2023–2030
organization: Government of the Republic of Serbia; Ministry of Environmental Protection
temporal_coverage: Adaptation programme 2023–2030; first action plan 2024–2026; climate projections through 2081–2100.
methodology: Serbian government programme read in full; English summaries are translated paraphrases.
limitations: Cited studies underpin projections; area shares are not exposed-population estimates.

title: Gender Analysis of the Impact of the 2014 Floods in Serbia
organization: Višnja Baćanović; supported by the OSCE Mission to Serbia
temporal_coverage: Interviews and flood-response observations from May–July 2014; report published 2015.
methodology: Study combines interviews with 78 flood-exposed residents in four municipalities and focus-group input from evacuation-centre volunteers.
limitations: Small event-specific sample; gender-disaggregated administrative records were incomplete. The report does not attribute the flood to climate change.

title: EU for Civil Protection and Disaster Risk Resilience Strengthening in the Republic of Serbia
temporal_coverage: Project ran March 2020–January 2026; page gives no INFORM score reference year.
methodology: Directly read UNDP project-page narrative and impact/status fields.
limitations: Page gives no score vintage or scale and reports project framing rather than evaluated outcomes; INFORM is not an FCV classification.

title: Sustainable Urban and Regional Development Program (SURGE): Annual Report 2025
temporal_coverage: World Bank FY2025 programme activities through June 2025; programme extension ended June 2026.
methodology: World Bank report; read full Serbia chapter and FY2025 results.
limitations: Self-reported FY2025 outputs, not resilience outcomes; programme ended June 2026.

title: Country Climate and Development Report: Western Balkans 6 — Background Note: Adapting to a Changing Climate, the Case for Urgent Action
temporal_coverage: Regional climate-development analysis and cited climate-conflict literature, 2024.
methodology: World Bank regional background note synthesizes climate-risk analysis, regional statistics and cited conflict literature.
limitations: Regional synthesis, not a Serbia-specific causal estimate; the note says a clear causal relationship is not unequivocally established.
